scope: Root narrow fixes from independently reproduced W06 findings; host tests only

recorder_interruption.finding: Termination errors or timeout replaced the first KeyboardInterrupt and could leave a direct child unreaped.
recorder_interruption.correction: Save interruption first, append bounded TERM/KILL cleanup errors, preserve inherited supervisor process group and record reaped exit.

substitution_closure.finding: Extra project/native-work LOADs and unreviewed project headers could pass despite a fixed selected link/compile recipe.
substitution_closure.correction: Require exact source/control-work/native-work LOAD multiset; reject unreviewed compiler inputs whose literal or resolved path enters those roots.
